title: Tim Knight's Textbook Short Just Fell Another 15% Overnight
speaker: Tim Knight (Slope of Hope), guest

macro_themes.view: After a strong run lower he cut shorts from 37 to 22 and expects a countertrend 'slope of hope' rally before a much bigger decline.
Bad news on hyperscalers, semis, memory and AI financing has largely been absorbed by the sell-off for now.

calls.reason: ES escaped below its 'orange line' tractor-beam level; expects a snapback rally (possibly on an administration gimmick) to shortable prices; still holds 22 smaller shorts.
calls.quote: the ES I think could easily snap back to our friendly little orange line there

calls.condition: Bounce view fails if NQ breaks below the session's intraday low; trend line from lifetime high was his target and was hit.
calls.reason: NQ broke the trend line from the July low and reached his descending trend-line target; expects a rally that gives bears another chance before a much bigger fall.
calls.quote: I think we're going to rally back. Fellow bears ... you're going to get another chance ... a much bigger fall is on the way

calls.reason: Textbook completed head-and-shoulders reversal; fell ~15% overnight. He covered his short yesterday and would like a rally to re-short.
calls.quote: this is the the arc archetype of a head and shoulders reversal

calls.reason: Tagged and slightly exceeded its descending trend line, oversold; took profits and hopes for a countertrend bounce back toward the prior rectangle.
calls.quote: what I'm hoping for is some kind of rally. Kind of your ... countertrend slope of hope type bounce

calls.reason: His biggest position and preferred rate-sensitive short; opened strong and trading weaker.
calls.quote: XLU, on the other hand, I'm enthusiastic about ... yes, it's a short it's a big short

calls.reason: Fell to ~140, below his ~150 support, printed a hammer and is springing back toward the support zone; supports his bounce view.
calls.quote: Got a little hammer there. We're at the highs of the day ... it's starting to spring back toward that that zone of support

notes: XLU direction from 'it's a big short' amid garbled wording; treated as short. ES/NQ/SMH: short-term bounce is a hope/expectation while still net short. SpaceX ticker not canonical ('SPACEX'). Host's own long TLT/consumer views not recorded.
